name: Appendiceal Adenocarcinoma - FOLFOX/CAPEOX backbone (coverage pointer)
histology: adenocarcinoma (mucinous, non-mucinous, or signet-ring-cell; graded low vs high per pathology review)
stage: as systemic component with cytoreductive surgery

biomarkers.grade: histologic grade (low- vs high-grade) and mucinous/signet-ring status drive management
biomarkers.MMR_MSI: biomarker testing (MMR/MSI, HER2, RAS, BRAF) recommended per pathology review
biomarkers.note: Systemic FOLFOX or CAPEOX (the colorectal cytotoxic backbone) is the preferred palliative systemic therapy for high-grade appendiceal adenocarcinoma. IMPORTANT: low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN) and low-grade disease are managed primarily by cytoreductive surgery with or without HIPEC, NOT by systemic cytotoxic chemotherapy. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Appendiceal Adenocarcinoma, APP-B (Pathology and Molecular Review) and APP-D (Principles of Palliative Systemic Therapy).

lineOfTherapy: preferred palliative systemic backbone (FOLFOX or CAPEOX) for high-grade/adenocarcinoma appendiceal disease; also used peri-operatively around cytoreductive surgery

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: appendiceal adenocarcinoma (high-grade or otherwise chemotherapy-appropriate); low-grade mucinous neoplasms are surgically managed
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v2.2026, APP-D (Principles of Palliative Systemic Therapy; FOLFOX or CAPEOX preferred; appendiceal lines 289, 434, 539, 571)

drugs.name: FOLFOX or CAPEOX backbone (see referenced Standard Protocol - dose not duplicated)

provenance.locator: APP-D (Preferred: FOLFOX or CAPEOX; appendiceal lines 289, 434, 539, 571)

drugs.notes: COVERAGE POINTER - dose intentionally NOT duplicated. High-grade appendiceal adenocarcinoma uses the same FOLFOX (fluorouracil/leucovorin/oxaliplatin) or CAPEOX (capecitabine/oxaliplatin) cytotoxic backbone as colorectal adenocarcinoma at the same doses; NCCN Appendiceal v2.2026 (APP-D) names these regimens but does not print distinct mg/m2 dosing tables. FOLFOX dosing is already modeled in this folder as folfox-4.json, folfox-6.json, and modified-folfox-6.json. dosePerUnit/basis/unit are VERIFY here solely to signal 'resolve by referencing the existing backbone Standard Protocol', not because any dose is unknown. Low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN) is surgically managed (cytoreduction +/- HIPEC), not with this backbone. Fluoropyrimidine DPYD testing per FDA boxed warning (APP footnote a).

supportiveCare: Systemic dosing and cycle length are defined by the referenced colorectal FOLFOX/CAPEOX Standard Protocols (folfox-4.json / modified-folfox-6.json in this folder); not duplicated here.
Low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasms are managed surgically (cytoreductive surgery +/- HIPEC), not with systemic cytotoxic chemotherapy.
Fluoropyrimidine DPYD testing per FDA boxed warning before starting capecitabine or fluorouracil.

monitoring: see the referenced FOLFOX/CAPEOX Standard Protocol for backbone monitoring (CBC, renal, oxaliplatin neuropathy)
peritoneal disease burden assessment (imaging; mucinous tumors may be better characterized on MRI)

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Appendiceal adenocarcinoma (high-grade) is treated with colorectal-type fluoropyrimidine/oxaliplatin chemotherapy; concrete FOLFOX/CAPEOX dosing is covered by the colorectal backbone Standard Protocols

guideline.locator: APP-D (Principles of Palliative Systemic Therapy; Preferred FOLFOX or CAPEOX; appendiceal lines 289, 434, 539, 571); APP-B (Principles of Pathology and Molecular Review; grade and mucinous/signet-ring classification, appendiceal lines 244 to 251)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol COVERAGE POINTER for appendiceal adenocarcinoma (disease #28). Per the task, the FOLFOX/CAPEOX backbone is NOT duplicated: NCCN Appendiceal v2.2026 (APP-D, Principles of Palliative Systemic Therapy) names FOLFOX or CAPEOX as the preferred systemic regimen (appendiceal lines 289, 434, 539, 571) but prints no distinct mg/m2 dosing - the doses are identical to the colorectal backbone already modeled in this folder as folfox-4.json, folfox-6.json, and modified-folfox-6.json (CAPEOX = capecitabine/oxaliplatin). The single regimen drug entry is a deliberate pointer whose dose fields, cycleLengthDays, and cycles are set to VERIFY and listed in verifyFields to signal 'resolve by referencing the existing colorectal FOLFOX/CAPEOX Standard Protocol', not because any dose is unknown or was inferred. Low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasms (LAMN) are surgically managed (cytoreduction +/- HIPEC), not with this backbone. Biomarker testing and fluoropyrimidine DPYD safety are noted. No dose was invented or inferred. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
